stats.source: The complete abilities_usecombathacking.log.txt witness records 1010 +22, 117 +24 and 1009 +22 for 32 s. The GOB preview for the same attributes lists +20/+15/+20.

behavior-tests.source: The archived stock request and reply record the selected-target activation, self-only buff, own reuse 298 s and 32 s linked modifiers.
behavior-tests.runtime: The normal cast and reuse route applies 344 to the caster independently of the selected friend. The three consumers are active only for the shared buff lifetime.
behavior-tests.test: HackerCombatHackingMode replays the complete stock request against a current friendly handle, asserts cost, bar, timer, source values, natural expiry and no 344 stat records on the selected friend. The test also observes the actual subsequent IS debit before, during and after the buff.
